title: Transitive symmetry of the AND function
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every pair of coordinates $i,i'\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, there is a permutation of the coordinates sending $i$ to $i'$ under which the function on $\{-1,1\}^n$ that outputs $-1$ when every coordinate is $-1$ and outputs $1$ otherwise is invariant.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ and $i'$ are coordinates in the $n$-dimensional cube
